resultText:
Committed. This is a backend-only task with no UI, so no screenshots needed.

<<<JSON
{ "summary": "Built src/store.ts (the SQLite data layer) with uniform rejection-sampled short-code generation and a collision retry that only swallows genuine unique-constraint errors, plus test/store.test.ts covering schema idempotency, code alphabet/uniqueness/distribution, alias handling, resolve, click recording and listing order. All gate commands and the full suite pass (12/12).", "notes_for_reviewer": "Fixed both known sketch bugs: makeCode used byte % 56 (biased toward the first 32 letters since 256 % 56 = 32); now uses rejection sampling. createLink's retry loop used a bare catch that swallowed any insert error; now it only retries on a confirmed UNIQUE constraint failure (node:sqlite reports these as code ERR_SQLITE_ERROR with 'UNIQUE constraint failed' in the message, not a distinct error class) and rethrows anything else." }
JSON>>>
